resources.string: This device could not be reached. On it, open Mitsflix Player → More → Local sync and turn Sync mode on. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Colour of the Mitsflix Player icon and logo
You chose a new icon and logo. They take effect after Mitsflix Player restarts.
What Mitsflix Player shows when it starts: Home, the channel you watched last, your favourites, or a channel you pick.
Looks on GitHub for a newer Mitsflix Player now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favourites and settings stay as they are.
Stage draws Mitsflix Player’s own soft colours. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
The Mitsflix Player logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent colour. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colours.
This address is for the Mitsflix Player app on your other device. Open Local sync there and pick this device from the list.
